answer: The delta multiplier is published, charged in pigment, and zephyr lists each payment. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, since the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 12 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A farm of 2404 identities would post 2397 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
